item.title: IndiGo offers travel vouchers of ₹10,000 to passengers stranded between Dec 5 to 7
item.description: Passengers of the IndiGo Airlines who were left stranded at the airports between December 3 and 5 will be given a compensation of ₹10,000 which will be valid for 12 months, the airlines said in a statement. This compensation will be in addition to the flight ticket refunds and in addition to the compensation of ₹5,000 to 10,000 mandated by the government. item.title: Ex-ISI chief Faiz Hameed sentenced to 14 years in jail by Pakistan court
item.description: A Pakistan military court on Thursday sentenced former chief of the Inter-Services Intelligence (ISI) Faiz Hameed to 14 years in prison, sources reported. The Field General Court Martial (FGCM) sentenced Hameed to jail over a year after court-martial proceedings against Hameed on multiple charges, including engaging in political activities and violating the Official Secrets Act.

item.title: Ahmedabad SOG raid seizes 7 kg of marijuana, 3 detained
item.description: The Special Operations Group (SOG) of the Ahmedabad Crime Branch on Thursday claimed to have seized nearly 7 kg of marijuana, cash amounting to ₹4.9 lakh, mobile phones and a digital weighing scale during a late-evening raid on Wednesday at a residential cluster in Bapunagar. Three persons, including two women, were detained, while the alleged mastermind, identified as Abdulkadir alias Babu Jawwad Khan Pathan, is absconding. item.title: Elite National Boxing Championships rescheduled due to pollution control measures
item.description: The elite men’s and women’s national boxing championships were rescheduled yesterday to January 4 to 10 due to pollution control measures mandated by the Government. The championships were earlier scheduled from December 31 to January 6 at Gautam Buddha University in Greater Noida. The Boxing Federation of India said that in light of the pollution control measures mandated by the Government and effective until 31st December 2025, the Championship will now be held from 4th January to 10th January

item.title: Prudential sells 4.5% stake in ICICI Pru AMC for ₹4,900 cr ahead of IPO
item.description: British insurer Prudential said on Thursday it has sold a 4.5 per cent stake in ICICI Prudential Asset Management for ₹4,900 crore (about $545 million) ahead of the Indian fund manager's $1.2 billion IPO that opens on Friday. The fund house is a joint venture between ICICI Bank, India's second-largest private lender, which holds 51 per cent, and Prudential, which owns the rest. item.title: After US, Mexico Slaps Up to 50% Tariffs on Indian Goods; Major Hit to Auto Exports
item.description: Mexico Joins US in Tightening Trade Rules, Announcing Up to 50% Tariffs on Indian Products in a Push to Protect Domestic Industry. item.title: Enhanced TOEFL iBT test ready for launch in January - ETS Hosts TOEFL Experience Days in Ahmedabad to share additions with educators and partners
item.description: ETS, the global leader in educational assessment and creator of the TOEFL iBT test, hosted a TOEFL Experience Days event in Ahmedabad on December 10, 2025. item.title: Swaroop Sampat-Rawal Recognized for Her Impact on Education with Fellowship from University of Worcester
item.description: Swaroop Sampat-Rawal, the celebrated Bollywood actress, former Miss India, and passionate educator, has been awarded a prestigious Fellowship by the University of Worcester in the UK.
